fire: Petals range from creamy white to dark purple.
The bark varies from pale grey to reddish brown.
Blooms can be any shade from soft yellow to bright orange.
La flor es de un rojo intenso.
Its wings are usually from light blue to violet.
Leaves turn from bright green to golden yellow.
El pétalo es de un azul pálido.
The shells vary in colour from pale pink to black.
quiet: Petals range from small to large in this species.
The bark varies from smooth to deeply cracked.
Blooms can appear at any time from early May to late June.
La flor es de un tamaño pequeño.
Its wings are usually from two to four inches wide.
Leaves grow from short stalks to form rosettes.
El pétalo es de una forma redonda.
The shells vary in size from tiny to huge.
